phase: Phase 7R: Post-7Q Production Validation, Score Behavior Audit & Next-Phase Readiness Review

pillar2_performance.name: Pillar 2: Individual Batting Execution (P2)
pillar2_performance.measures: Individual run volume and scoring rate deviation relative to situational expectations, damped by opportunity usage.
pillar2_performance.should_measure: Pure individual batting quality, agnostic of match result or subsequent partner outcomes.
pillar2_performance.unintentional_interactions: Zero coupling with P3. Normalizes through a sigmoid mapping onto [0.1, 99.9]. Standardized Z-scale prevents run-volume bias over strike rate.
pillar2_performance.mathematical_justification: Robust and justified: z_run + 0.5 * z_sr * sqrt(opp_usage) correctly rewards high volume and tempo while dampening 1-ball anomalies.

pillar3_team_state.name: Pillar 3: Team-State Transformation / Preservation (P3)
pillar3_team_state.measures: The change in team competitive position (projected score delta in 1st innings; required rate/progress relief in chases) plus decoupled state-preservation floor for elite platforms.
pillar3_team_state.should_measure: The extent to which the batter moved the needle for the team, OR successfully maintained an elite team state that physically had little room for additional expansion.
pillar3_team_state.unintentional_interactions: Without Phase 7Q floor, elite platform maintenance collapsed into 50-54. With Phase 7Q floor (64.0), maintenance receives appropriate credit without passenger inflation.
pillar3_team_state.mathematical_justification: Fully justified: 1st innings derivative delta_EFS is physical; 2nd innings Model E soft saturation prevents blowouts; Phase 7Q anti-free-rider gate ensures independence and prevents free riders.

context_leverage.name: Situational Context & Match Leverage (L)
context_leverage.measures: The crisis / pressure level at crease entry, combining wicket crisis (C_wkt) and chase pressure (C_chase) into C_eff and bounded leverage L in [0.65, 1.35].
context_leverage.should_measure: A scaling factor around neutral par (50.0) that magnifies achievements/failures in crises and attenuates achievements/failures in garbage time.
context_leverage.unintentional_interactions: Does NOT act as a performance penalty. For any above-average performance (P > 50), Adjusted P remains strictly > 50. Par (50.0) is mathematically invariant.
context_leverage.mathematical_justification: Dual-slope Model B ensures par continuity L(50)=1.000, bounds volatility within [0.65, 1.35], and eliminates arbitrary linear weighting.

adjusted_pillars.measures: Pillars rotated around neutral par (50.0) by match leverage.

final_contribution.formula: Final = clip(0.50 * Adjusted P2 + 0.50 * Adjusted P3, 0.1, 99.9)
final_contribution.property: The Final Contribution Score is the unweighted average of individual execution (P2) and team impact (P3), scaled by match leverage around par 50.

leverage_grid_audit.conclusion: Leverage L acts strictly as context-as-leverage: Par 50.0 is invariant; deviations from par are scaled proportionally; scores > 50 never become < 50; scores < 50 never become > 50. It does not penalize good batting but calibrates credit to situational stakes.

case_a_weak_platform_transform.evaluation: P3 is naturally very high (89.8); transformation correctly recognized.

case_b_avg_platform_transform.evaluation: P3 is naturally high (75.2); transformation correctly recognized.

case_c_strong_platform_maintain.evaluation: P3 receives preservation floor (64.0); recognized above par 50 but strictly below major transformations.

case_d_strong_platform_deteriorate.evaluation: P3 remains low (7.4); state deterioration strictly blocks preservation floor.

case_e_strong_platform_passenger.evaluation: P3 remains neutral (50.1); personal RR 4.0 < 8.5 strictly blocks free-riding.

case_f_golden_duck.evaluation: P3 remains severely penalized (16.4); 0 off 1 is strictly excluded.

case_g_comfortable_chase.evaluation: Comfortable chase correctly scales leverage to 0.900; Final=75.6 reflects strong performance without over-inflation.

case_h_difficult_chase.evaluation: Difficult chase recognizes HIGH CHASE PRESSURE (L=1.028); appropriately amplifies contributions under pressure.

case_i_shortened_innings.evaluation: Phase 7O early-over fallback executes cleanly (P3=96.3, Final=94.1); preservation floor is bypassed.

case_j_post_4_over_entry.evaluation: Standard Model E and Phase 7Q preservation apply correctly to post-4-over entry.

case_k_dnb.evaluation: DNB strictly returns None and never counts as 0.

case_m_outcome_invariance.evaluation: Zero leakage from future match outcome or winning margin (delta=0.00000000).

p3_semantic_audit.q1_p3_equals_50: P3 = 50.0 represents exact league-average, par team-state impact. The batter's presence at the crease left the team's projected total (1st innings) or win probability / required rate (2nd innings) in essentially the same position as the historical expectation for that entry state. Neither an acceleration nor a deterioration.
p3_semantic_audit.q2_p3_equals_60: P3 = 60.0 represents meaningful positive team-state impact or solid team-state preservation. The batter visibly improved the projected score (e.g. +5 to +8 runs above par) or successfully maintained an elite team platform (64.0 floor prior to context scaling). It sits at approximately the 65th-70th percentile of all team impacts.
p3_semantic_audit.q3_p3_equals_70: P3 = 70.0 represents high positive team-state transformation. The batter significantly altered match trajectory: adding +12 to +16 runs to expected final score or reducing required run rate by 1.5 to 2.5 RPO in a chase while liquidating 25%+ of the target. Upper quartile (P75 = 66.8).
p3_semantic_audit.q4_p3_equals_80: P3 = 80.0 represents game-changing transformation. The batter took an average or struggling platform and decisively elevated it (+20 to +25 runs delta_EFS), or transformed a difficult chase into a commanding winning position. Roughly 85th percentile.
p3_semantic_audit.q5_p3_equals_90: P3 = 90.0 represents elite, match-winning transformation. A decisive shift turning likely defeat into dominant victory (+30 to +40 runs delta_EFS, or collapsing a steep 12+ RPO chase). Top 10% of historical innings (P90 = 90.6).
p3_semantic_audit.q6_maintaining_strong_state_above_50: YES. Par (50) represents an average team trajectory. Maintaining an elite platform (11+ RPO, EFS >= 180) against top bowling is an above-average cricket achievement. Scoring 50 off 25 balls from 110/1 at 10 ov to 165/2 at 14.1 ov keeps the run rate at 11.7 RPO, but physical saturation prevents delta_EFS from exceeding +2 runs. Awarding P3 = 50 treats elite maintenance as mediocre. Setting a floor of 64.0 correctly places it above neutral par.
p3_semantic_audit.q7_objective_measurable_conditions: Preservation conditions must be strictly physical and independent of P2: (1) Strong inherited platform (EFS >= 180 runs or chase RRR <= 7.5); (2) State preservation (delta_EFS >= -2.5 runs or delta_RRR >= -0.5 RPO); (3) High team window tempo (window_team_rr >= 9.0 RPO or target_progress >= 0.20); (4) Anti-free-rider personal tempo (personal_rr >= 8.5 RPO or personal_rr >= RRR_entry); (5) Minimum involvement (balls >= 8 or runs >= 15); (6) Exclusions: no golden ducks (0 off 1) and no DNB.
p3_semantic_audit.q8_preventing_passenger_credit: Enforced via the Anti-Free-Rider Gate (personal_rr >= 8.5 in 1st inn; >= RRR_entry in chase). If a partner scores rapidly while the batter scores 8 off 12 (personal RR = 4.0), the batter fails the gate and receives their natural unfloored score (~50.1), preventing any free-riding.
p3_semantic_audit.q9_achieving_without_using_p2: YES. The gate operates exclusively on physical signals: actual_runs, balls_faced, and personal_rr = (actual_runs / balls_faced) * 6.0. It never accesses P2, score_perf, run_deviation, sr_deviation, or z_perf. Testing shows delta_P3 = 0.00000000 when P2 is varied under constant physical stats.
p3_semantic_audit.q10_phase_7q_adequacy: YES. Phase 7Q Model B completely and safely solves this issue: exactly 368 innings (1.93%) corrected; 49 high-P2/compressed-P3 cases rescued; zero passengers admitted; zero golden ducks affected; zero DNB altered; 100% test pass rate (415/415); zero macro distortion (+0.19 pts population mean shift).

final_decision_gate.recommendation: A. CURRENT MODEL IS MATHEMATICALLY SOUND — NO CHANGE REQUIRED
final_decision_gate.justification: The post-Phase-7Q audit proves that the current production scoring model is mathematically sound, cricket-wise validated, and operates with high precision across all 19,111 historical appearances. The 4 core team states (transformation, preservation, deterioration, passenger) are strictly distinguished; the leverage architecture appropriately scales context without acting as a hidden penalty; zero model defects were detected; and all 415 existing repository tests continue passing with 100% success rate.
